text:
Alex: heads-up, PR 873 has a failing docs preview — Netlify linkcheck reports missing anchors after the mkdocs material upgrade
Nina: I saw the preview. Some headings got different slugs so internal links 404. CI shows it on the deploy preview at https://deploy-preview-873--docs.redwood.ai.netlify.app
Omar: was this caused by the slugify change? We had `python-slugify` bump last week
Alex: likely. Two options: add explicit HTML anchors or normalize slugify behavior in CI
Nina: for quick unblock, I prefer explicit anchors placed just above the h2s we changed. Less surprise for backports
Omar: agree. Also noticed one SDK code block still references the old package name `from redwood import Client` — that will break copy-paste examples
Alex: thanks, Omar. I'll push a commit that adds explicit anchors and corrects the import to `from redwood_inference import Client`
docs-bot: CI: linkcheck failed for PR #873 — see https://ci.internal/reports/873
NetlifyBot: Preview updated: https://deploy-preview-873--docs.redwood.ai.netlify.app (linkcheck rerun queued)
Nina: small reminder: when testing locally use `pipx run mkdocs build` to match CI build, and open the built site instead of `mkdocs serve` which can differ in plugin versions
Omar: also if your assets are symlinked under static/, Netlify might not copy them the same way. Use a build script step like `cp -R static/* site/` or `rsync` so previews match prod
Alex: pushed fixes; PR description documents the reasoning and requests merge during the docs merge window at 17:30 PT to avoid preview churn
docs-bot: docs-ci started for PR #873 — linkcheck and preview build running
NetlifyBot: Preview updated: https://deploy-preview-873--docs.redwood.ai.netlify.app — linkcheck PASS :white_check_mark:
Nina: I spot-checked the SDK snippet in an isolated venv and the import works. Approving; will hold merge until 17:30 PT as requested
Omar: follow-up: create a tiny CONTRIBUTING note to run `pipx run mkdocs --version` to avoid future mismatches
Alex: will open that follow-up PR after merge. Thanks folks!
